title: Maison Rouge meeting
summary: JASON tells of Maison Rouge meeting, about 1944 at Paris, France, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So Martin Bormann assembles all the leaders of industry into this meeting in Paris, very secret meeting, they sweep the rooms to make sure no one can hear what they're going to talk about.

plain: A guest named Jason, citing the author Peter Levenda, describes a 1944 meeting in Paris called the Maison Rouge meeting. He says Martin Bormann, one of Hitler's top officials, secretly gathered the leaders of German industry there, and the rooms were swept so no one could listen in. He raises it while tracing where today's UFO secrecy might lead back to, suggesting a hidden network that outlived the war.
